title: Thus spake Zarathustra.
html_source: Thus Spoke Zarathustra is a philosophical work by Friedrich Nietzsche which tells of the deeds and wisdom of Zarathustra or Zoroaster. As with many of Nietzsche’s works, the book contains a lot of harsh criticisms of Christian values.
